name: Venompool

abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Vicious: Hasar veren debuff'ların gücünü belirtilen miktarda artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.

signatureAbility:
Don't Stop Evolvin'
Venompool begins each Quest with 1 Persistent Charge, which he can spend in the Pre-Fight Menu to select one Blender Buff as his Fav Food for the next fight. The Fav Food is more likely to be chosen at random and gains +[10 - 60]% Potency.
Each time Venompool enters a fight, he gains his Persistent Charge back.
immunityDetails:
• Güç Emme/Yakma Bağışıklığı (Tech şampiyonlara karşı) 🔋
• Şok Bağışıklığı (Tech'e karşı) ⚡️
• Yakma Bağışıklığı (Tech'e karşı + şu sinerjiyle: Red Hulk) 🔥
• Zırh Kırma Bağışıklığı (Tech şampiyonlara karşı) 🛡️

abilitySections.title: Cookin' Meter
content: Venompool has a Cookin' Meter which begins at 50 Charges and gains 10 more Charges every 5 second(s).
Attacks from either Champion grants 4 Charges.
Each time the Cookin' Meter hits 100, that amount is spent to grant a random, unique, indefinite “Blender Buff” which can be found at the bottom of the info page.

abilitySections.title: Illogical DNA - While Fighting Tech Champions
content: Gain Immunity to Power Drain, Power Burn and Shock effects as well as Armor Break Debuffs. If an effect is prevented this way, gain 50 Cookin' Meter. Cooldown 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Reroll the most recently gained Blender Buff.
If the opponent is knocked down, 100% chance to gain a Vicious Buff increasing the Potency of Damage-Over-Time Debuffs by 60%. This lasts for 5 seconds per Unique Buff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: 100% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff lasting 6 seconds and causing [12,495.6] direct damage per level of Special Attack used.
While fighting #Robot Champions, this Bleed Debuff becomes a matching Degeneration Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit has a 75% chance to Om Nom 1 of each Unique Buff on the opponent, removing it and granting 50 Cookin' Meter.
If the Om Nommed Buff was an Armor Up, also gain a Regeneration Buff, recovering [14,533] Health over 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: If this attack Intercepts the opponent, 100% chance to inflict a Stun Debuff lasting 3 seconds.
If Venompool is able to finish his moonwalk after the attack he gains a temporary duplicate of each of his Blender Buffs, lasting 20 seconds.
If his dance is interrupted, Venompool instead gains a Power Gain Buff, granting 1 Bar(s) of Power over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Venompool's Cookin' Meter becomes Spicy for 20 seconds, which causes it to build up twice as fast.
If the Cookin' Meter hits 100 while it is Spicy, all personal Bleed and Degeneration Debuffs on the opponent are Paused for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Blender Buffs - Cookin' Meter Above 100
content: Precision: +[916.67] Critical Rating.
Energize: +15% Combat Power Rate.
Klyntar Mutation: Grants +[3,123.9] Attack Rating. If the opponent is a Spider-Verse Champion, attacks ignore Passive Evade effects.
Hunter-Spider: Attacks deal a burst of additional 25% Physical Damage.
Malice: Up to +100% Fury Buff Potency based on how long the fight has gone on. Max Bonus at 200 seconds.
Blender Buffs don't stack. Once Venompool has acquired all 5 other Blender Buffs, he will instead gain stacking Fury Buffs, with each granting +[2,082.6] Attack Rating for 60 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Don't Stop Evolvin'
content: Venompool begins each Quest with 1 Persistent Charge, which he can spend in the Pre-Fight Menu to select one Blender Buff as his Fav Food for the next fight. The Fav Food is more likely to be chosen at random and gains +[10 - 60]% Potency.
Each time Venompool enters a fight, he gains his Persistent Charge back.
